newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel demand firm on back of strong gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel demand firm on back of strong gas oil.

text.p: Demand for heating kerosene into Britain and Scandinavia and scattered jet demand around the continent gave firm support to NWE jet fuel premiums on Friday, traders said.
Feb IPE gas oil futures ended down $4.50 at $226.25 a tonne as temperatures in Europe started to climb back to normal levels after a cold snap.
Cargo premiums were around Feb IPE +32/33 cif NWE. Barges were around Feb IPE +$31 fob ARA. Med cargoes were around Feb +$18/19 fob Med.
